title: Texans GM Nick Caserio: No knee-jerk reactions, significant personnel changes right now

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Texans GM Nick Caserio: No knee-jerk reactions, significant personnel changes right now
sources.description: The Texans had a chance to head into their bye week on a three-game winning streak, but they couldn't score any points to open overtime against the Giants and their run defense broke down as the visitors rolled to a game-winning touchdown by former Texan Devin Singletary.
